decoder: Dart image 4.12.0; bakeOrientation; RGB; lossless PNG of decoded original JPEG
resize: floor top-left aspect fit, aligned-corner bilinear in double precision; clamp and truncate channels to uint8; no JPEG re-encode; not bit-exact TensorFlow benchmark preprocessing
interpolationExpression: ((a + (b - a) * dx) * (1 - dy) + (c + (d - c) * dx) * dy).toInt().clamp(0, 255), where a/b/c/d are top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right source channel values; preserve this operation order for full-byte comparison
independentReferenceOrigin: Pre-Task-2 comparison input /private/tmp/color-lab-public-api.CQKdyz/photo-output/input.rgb; preserved verbatim. Output anchors frozen from separate actual MOSAIC UINT8 comparison, not production runner.
limitations: Sparse anchors are sanity checks, not dense ground truth. Visible person/furniture, ornate surface, floor and pillow errors remain. Histogram/hash are fixed host reference diagnostics, not promises of bit-exact cross-device inference.
